concerns.text: FR-003 requires automatic detection of outcome variable type (binary vs. continuous) to select regression family. Task T014a implements this logic and writes `outcome_type.json`, but it is marked as unchecked `[ ]`. Without T014a completion, the adaptive model selection in T021a cannot execute, leaving FR-003 unimplemented.

FR-003 mandates fitting a Mixed-Effects model for within-subjects data. Task T021a (`fit_adaptive_model`) depends on `data/processed/model_config.json` (generated by T021b-GenerateConfig). T021b is marked `[ ]` (unchecked). Consequently, the core requirement to adapt the model to data structure is unimplemented.

FR-001 requires producing a cleaned CSV (`data/processed/cleaned_data.csv`) with specific columns and missing value handling. Task T013 is responsible for writing this file but is marked `[ ]` (unchecked). This blocks all downstream analysis tasks (T014a, T021b, T030) that depend on this artifact.

SC-003 requires measuring the 'width of the 95% Confidence Interval' for the interaction coefficient. Task T023c-ValidateCIWidth explicitly calculates this and writes `ci_width` to `model_output.json`, but it is marked `[ ]`. The parent task T023 (generating the output file) is also unchecked, leaving SC-003 unverified.

FR-004 requires calculating and reporting VIF for all predictors. Task T022 is marked with `[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM]` and lacks a clear 'completed' state or associated test execution confirmation, leaving the requirement potentially unverified.

SC-002 requires verifying that the p-value remains < 0.05 across the outlier threshold sweep {2.5, 3.0, 3.5}. Task T031b-ValidateStability (measuring this and writing `stability_metric.json`) is marked `[ ]` and depends on T030 (sensitivity sweep), which is also unchecked. This creates a gap in verifying SC-002.

Task T050 references a typo in `plan.md` regarding sensitivity sweep thresholds. While the task exists to fix the plan, the presence of 'Post-Implementation' tasks correcting the plan suggests the plan was not finalized before task generation. This is a workflow inversion (writing issue) but the tasks themselves cover the requirement.
